name: Pension Scheme to Old Age Persons (Senior Citizen)-DNH&DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit:
**Quantum & Nature of Assistance:**
1.	Senior citizens aged 60–69 years: Monthly pension of ₹1,500/-.
2.	Senior citizens aged 70 years and above: Monthly pension of ₹2,000/-.
**Note:** The mode of fund transfer shall be Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

all.value: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu

_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a domicile of the Dadra &amp; Nagar Haveli and Daman &amp; Diu.
   1. The applicant should be 60 years or older.
   1. The applicant&#39;s annual family income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/-.
   1. The applicant should not be receiving financial assistance under any other old age pension scheme.
